images.alt_grc: ὁ Ἀρίστων καὶ ὁ Σύρος κύλικας καὶ ὑδρίας εἰς τὴν ἀγορὰν φέρουσιν.
images.alt_en: Ariston and Syros carry cups and water jars out of the workshop towards the agora; Lysis follows with a basket of cups. Spring light.

images.alt_grc: ἀνὴρ δύο κύλικας σκοπεῖ· ἡ μὲν μείζων, ἡ δὲ μικροτέρα.
images.alt_en: In the agora a customer holds up two cups, one larger and one smaller, while Ariston gestures at the price; Lysis watches.

images.alt_grc: ἑσπέρας ὁ Ἀρίστων τὸ ἀργύριον ἀριθμεῖ.
images.alt_en: Evening at home: Ariston counts small silver coins on the table; Lysis asks a question; Labros sniffs at the coins.

images.alt_grc: ξένος τις εἰς τὸ ἐργαστήριον εἰσέρχεται.
images.alt_en: A travelling merchant in a broad hat and cloak stands in the workshop doorway greeting Ariston at the wheel.

images.alt_grc: ὁ ἔμπορος τὰς κύλικας σκοπεῖ· «αὕτη μὲν καλή, ἐκείνη δὲ καλλίων.»
images.alt_en: The merchant points at three cups at different distances (this one here, that one, that one over there); Ariston counts on his fingers.

images.alt_grc: ἡ Ἐλπὶς τὸν ξένον περὶ τῆς θαλάττης ἐρωτᾷ.
images.alt_en: Evening in the courtyard: the merchant tells stories by lamplight; Elpis listens with shining eyes; Kleinias nods.

images.alt_grc: ἡ Χρυσὶς πρὸς τῷ ἱστῷ ἵσταται καὶ ὑφαίνει.
images.alt_en: Chrysis stands at a tall upright warp-weighted loom, passing the shuttle; loom weights hang at the bottom; Elpis sits nearby with a basket of wool.

images.alt_grc: ἡ Ἐλπὶς πρὸς τὸν ἱστὸν ἔστη καὶ τὴν κερκίδα ἔλαβεν.
images.alt_en: Elpis at the loom, tongue between her teeth, the wool slipping from her hands; Chrysis guides her from behind.

images.alt_grc: ὁ Κλεινίας τὴν κόρην ὁρᾷ· ἡ κόρη ὀρθῶς ὑφαίνει.
images.alt_en: Kleinias in the doorway, leaning on his stick, watches Elpis weaving a neat band of cloth; Chrysis smiles.

images.alt_grc: ὁ Προμηθεὺς ἐξ ὕδατος καὶ γῆς ἀνθρώπους πλάττει.
images.alt_en: Prometheus, a bearded Titan, kneels shaping small human figures out of clay, like a potter; finished figures stand up and walk away.

images.alt_grc: ὁ Προμηθεὺς τὸ πῦρ ἐν νάρθηκι κρύπτει.
images.alt_en: Prometheus creeps down from the sky at night carrying a glowing ember hidden inside a fennel stalk; men below reach up towards it.

images.alt_grc: ὁ ἀετὸς τὸ ἧπαρ τοῦ Προμηθέως ἐσθίει· ὁ Ἡρακλῆς αὐτὸν λύει.
images.alt_en: Prometheus nailed to a mountain crag with an eagle at his side; in the distance Heracles climbs up with bow and club.
A hand pointing at a cup with a question mark, and coins with a price beside it.
Two cups side by side: a large one labelled μείζων and a small one labelled μικροτέρα.
Three cups of rising quality with the three degrees of the adjective underneath, and the two ways to say 'than': ἤ + same case, or the genitive.
A round-hulled merchant sailing ship with a single square sail.
Storm clouds, rain and a rough sea; a ship pulled up on the beach.
A map arrow from Miletus (πόθεν;) across the sea to Athens (ποῦ;) and on to Piraeus (ποῖ;).

images.alt_grc: τῇ τρίτῃ ἡμέρᾳ · τρεῖς ἡμέρας · νυκτός
images.alt_en: A strip of days: a dot on one day (dative, time when), a bar across several days (accusative, how long), a shaded night (genitive, time within which).
A basket of white wool and a spindle.
An upright warp-weighted loom with clay weights hanging from the threads.
A woman wearing a peplos pinned at the shoulders, with the overfold.
A weaver's shuttle wound with thread.
A head in profile with a small lamp glowing inside it.
A woman points to show a girl how a thread runs through the loom.
A hand filling a cup to the brim from a jug.
A girl gazes admiringly at a woman and copies her gesture.
Left: a girl lifts a small jar with ease (tick). Right: she cannot lift a huge one (cross).
A woman weaving confidently, a finished cloth beside her; a badge reads 'knows how'.
Three stick figures: one stepping (ἔβη), one with a lightbulb (ἔγνω), one standing still (ἔστη), with the endings -ν -ς - -μεν -τε -σαν.
A simple outline of a human torso with the liver highlighted.
A tall giant-fennel stalk, hollow and pithy inside, with a glowing ember tucked in its core.
A high rocky mountain with a snowy top.
Hands shaping a small figure out of clay.
A boy hides a cup under a cloak; only the handle shows.
A man unties the rope from a prisoner's wrists.
A hammer driving a nail through a board into a rock face.

images.alt_grc: ἡ γλαῦξ· τὸ τετράδραχμον τῶν Ἀθηναίων.
images.alt_en: An Athenian silver tetradrachm, c. 450–430 BC: helmeted Athena on the obverse, the owl with olive sprig, crescent moon and ΑΘΕ on the reverse (museum photograph, CC).
Map of the Aegean showing Athens and Piraeus, the islands, and Miletus on the Ionian coast; the sailing route is marked.

Black-figure lekythos attributed to the Amasis Painter, c. 550–530 BC (Metropolitan Museum): two women weave at an upright warp-weighted loom while others spin and fold cloth (museum photograph, CC0).

images.alt_grc: ὁ Προμηθεὺς καὶ ὁ ἀετός· κύλιξ Λακωνική.
images.alt_en: Laconian black-figure cup, c. 560–550 BC (Vatican Museums): Atlas holding up the sky and Prometheus bound to a column with the eagle at his liver (museum photograph, CC).
